Automated by `registry-graph.yml`. The public registry ([`bounded-systems/site` → `data/registry.json`](https://github.com/bounded-systems/site/blob/main/data/registry.json)) changed, so the knowledge-graph block on the org profile no longer renders what the registry says.

Generated by `node scripts/gen-registry-graph.mjs`; the same code backs the `--check` drift gate that runs on pull requests, so the gate and the fix cannot disagree.

The commit is made through the GitHub API (`createCommitOnBranch`), not `git commit` in the runner — a runner-made commit carries no signature and this repo requires verified ones, so a pushed commit would have produced a PR that could never merge (#129).

The branch is fixed (`registry-graph/sync`), so a later run with newer registry data updates this PR in place rather than opening a second one that supersedes it.
